title: Strong winds spread 'large fire' near Wainwright, Alta., military base, municipality says
summary: A large fire originating on a Canadian Forces Base in east-central Alberta has spread rapidly due to Saturday's strong winds, according to the Municipal District of Wainwright.

image.caption: The Municipal District of Wainwright said on social media just after 5 p.m. MT that a large fire originating at CFB Wainwright has spread rapidly due to strong winds. (CBC)

blocks.text: A large fire originating on a Canadian Forces Base in east-central Alberta has spread rapidly due to Saturday's strong winds, according to the Municipal District of Wainwright.
Carney says 'serious incident' at CFB Wainwright led to major fire

The municipality said emergency responders are actively assessing the situation and "working to protect people, property and critical infrastructure" in the area. It added that multiple agencies are responding to the incident south of the town of Wainwright.
"Avoid the area and keep roads clear for emergency vehicles. Do not travel toward the incident or attempt to view it," the municipality said in a social media post Saturday just after 5 p.m. MT.
In a news release just after 6 p.m., Acute Care Alberta said Emergency Health Services is on scene "and supporting care and transport related to an incident at CFB Wainwright."
Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a social media post just after 6 p.m. that a "serious incident creating a major fire occurred at CFB Wainwright."

"Our thoughts are with all the brave women and men affected," Carney wrote in the post. "We are working closely with the Government of Alberta and local authorities. Premier Smith and I are in close contact, as are our relevant ministers and officials."
